data.spiritual_meaning: Asha expresses “Hope, Joy, Delight”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asha total 11, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_latin.name: Asha
in_latin.meaning: Originating from Sanskrit, meaning hope, life, or breath
in_latin.long_meaning: In Christian tradition, Asha is a name symbolizing eternal hope and life in Christ, reflecting the promise of salvation and new life through faith. Its Sanskrit roots convey the idea of breath or life force, emphasizing the spiritual breath of God's presence in believers.
